authority_boundary: Operator-authorized Drive deletions only. This receipt records observed actions and hash equivalence; it does not establish scientific truth, runtime correctness, or implementation status.

reconciliation.rule: Do not invent or backfill missing Drive IDs. Unreconciled prior deletions remain unresolved until independently reconstructed from receipts or source logs.

verification_policy.stored_binary: raw SHA-256 equality plus same-parent/redundancy context and no repository binding for deleted Drive ID or content hash
verification_policy.cross_surface_exception: Byte-identical files under semantically distinct install surfaces such as .gemini/skills and .agents/skills are not redundant replicas solely by hash equality.
verification_policy.delete_rule: Delete only verified redundant replicas after selecting a surviving canonical Drive object. REVISION, UNKNOWN, execution-distinct SESSION_TELEMETRY, and cross-surface mirrors are not deletable by this rule.

cross_surface_guard_evidence.finding: Large Jul-23/Aug-5 skill trees contain byte/metadata mirrors across distinct install surfaces; retain both because path/authority context is part of artifact identity.
